description: Sapphire substage spans for the selected stage, as coloured bands.
sql: SELECT * FROM (WITH base AS (SELECT MIN(a.substage_label) AS substage_label, CAST(a.record_ts AS timestamp) AS ts FROM featurestore:nextier_substage_sapphire_sept3_labels_v2 a WHERE a.well_name = :well_name AND CAST(a.stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION) = :stage_num AND a.record_ts IS NOT NULL AND a.substage_label IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(a.substage_label) <> 'na' GROUP BY CAST(a.record_ts AS timestamp)), marked AS (SELECT substage_label, ts, CASE WHEN LAG(substage_label) OVER (ORDER BY ts) IS DISTINCT FROM substage_label THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_group FROM base), grouped AS (SELECT substage_label, ts, SUM(is_new_group) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS group_id FROM marked) SELECT substage_label, MIN(ts) AS start_ts, MAX(ts) AS end_ts, CASE LOWER(substage_label) WHEN 'open_well' THEN '#2563EB' WHEN 'stage_start' THEN '#16A34A' WHEN 'ttr' THEN '#9333EA' WHEN 'pad' THEN '#F97316' WHEN 'slurry' THEN '#DC2626' WHEN 'flush' THEN '#0D9488' WHEN 'stage_end' THEN '#DB2777' WHEN 'close_well' THEN '#EAB308' ELSE '#787878' END AS color, COUNT(*) AS sample_count FROM grouped GROUP BY group_id, substage_label ORDER BY MIN(ts)) q
